title: Invar-RAG: Invariant LLM-aligned Retrieval for Better Generation
authors: Ziwei Liu; Liang Zhang; Qian Li; Jianghua Wu; Guangxu Zhu
why_relevant: Proposes LLM-aligned retrieval with invariance loss for RAG; touches on retrieval robustness/variance but not focused on unreliable evidence, conflict, attacks, or calibration.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on improving retrieval alignment for ODQA accuracy, not on robustness to noisy/adversarial/conflicting evidence.
